summary_1line: Sukesha’s three powerful sons perform austerities, gain boons from Brahma, oppress the worlds, and settle in the golden city of Lanka with their families.

image_candidates.scene_text: The three Rakshasa brothers stand emaciated in fierce penance on Mount Meru as Brahma descends in a radiant chariot from the sky.
Vishvakarma describes the golden-walled city of Lanka atop the Trikuta mountain rising above the southern sea.
The Rakshasa hosts enter the glittering city of Lanka with its golden palaces and massive gates surrounded by the ocean.
